description.fun: Shelmet shuts the lid of its knight's-helmet shell when attacked and spits a sticky, poisonous liquid, but that defence is useless against Karrablast, its rival and natural predator. For some reason, the two evolve together when bathed in electric-like energy at the same time. Its look may draw on the scaly-foot snail, whose shell contains iron, and on medieval drawings of knights battling giant snails.
description.guide: Shelmet is a Bug-type snail Pokémon with a helmet-like shell it closes to defend itself. It evolves into Accelgor when traded for a Karrablast, which evolves into Escavalier at the same time.
description.tagline: A snail in a knight's helmet that can't keep Karrablast out.

description.fun: Free of the heavy shell that Karrablast takes when they evolve together, Accelgor became light and nimble, fighting with ninja-like moves at blinding speed and lobbing poison at foes. Its body weakens if it dries out, so it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane like a ninja's bandages. Its sulky pout and crossed arms come from missing its shell. Making Accelgor the lead is said to be a surefire way to turn a movie or comic into a hit.
description.guide: Accelgor is the evolved form of Shelmet, a Bug-type Pokémon that shed its shell and fights with ninja-like speed. It wraps itself in membrane to avoid drying out.
description.tagline: A shell-less snail ninja that moves at blinding speed.
